name: CaseGridRowSpan
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-row-span" (grid-placement). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: grid-row: 2 / span 2 (child spans 2 rows)
